note: locations.several.serve-shows-each-screen, new (Topher, 2026-10-05); driven against a real walkdown serve on port 4791 on a throwaway machine.

results.reasoning: On a throwaway machine, project shop held blueprints a and b, sharing one as-built/, with prototype roots proto-a/ and proto-b/. I started `walkdown serve --port 4791` in shop with no blueprint named, and asked for each page with curl and no ?bp=. /as-built/home.html is one file for both and came back 200 with its contents. /prototype/screens/only-a.html exists only in a's root and came back 200 from a. /prototype/screens/both.html exists in both roots as different files and came back 409: 'is a different file in a and b - name one with ?bp=<id>'. /prototype/screens/nowhere.html came back 404. The same page with ?bp=b was served from b, and ?bp=a still serves as-built. One thing found and fixed before this verdict: the 404 used to say 'no blueprint named', which blamed the wrong thing. It now says the path 'is in no blueprint registered here', and the test asserts that.
